newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank lifts special T-Bill rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank lifts special T-Bill rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Tuesday raised its rates on special series Treasury bills in step with the increase in rates at Monday's weekly Treasury bill auction, traders said.
The 71-day rate was moved up to 11.50 from 11.45 percent; and the 149-day to 11.80 from 11.75 percent.
Treasury bill rates had risen due to high demand for pesos as a long weekend at the end of October left banks covering their positions in the following week, dealers said.
Some said banks had started to build their liquidity positions ahead of the expected seasonal tightness brought about by Christmas spending.
On Monday, the benchmark 91-day T-bill rate spiked up to an average of 11.766 from 11.562 percent.
